basis: 2026-10-24 SEC-DEPS-01 analysis of GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w surfaced by Foundation runtime 40077009661. Payments pins setuptools 80.9.0, which cannot be changed to 84.1.0 without a dependency conflict (Foundation run 40076515818). The advisory concerns an exclusively Windows-specific legacy setuptools Wheel.install_as_egg namespace path. The product's Frappe/Python runtime and all Python package installations run inside a Linux container, while the Windows customer host operates PowerShell/CMD launchers and docker load/compose only.

advisories.summary: setuptools legacy Windows wheel installation path escape through dist-info/namespace_packages.txt
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: GitHub advisory GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w requires native Windows path resolution during setuptools.wheel.Wheel.install_as_egg() of an attacker-controlled legacy wheel. TOEFL House's shipped Python application is built with FROM python:${PYTHON_VERSION}-slim-bookworm in product/app.Dockerfile and runs under Docker Linux containers on Windows Desktop. The image installer invokes pip/uv inside that Linux image, not a native Windows interpreter; product customer packaging tools/release/create_customer_package.py ALLOWED_FILES includes only Windows VBS/PowerShell/CMD launchers, Compose, guides and a prebuilt Linux Docker image, no Windows Python interpreter/wheel installation facility. Foundation audit 40077009661 is executed on ubuntu-24.04. A test protects the Linux-image/Windows-host launcher boundary. Re-triage if a native Windows Python installer, embedded Windows Python runtime, or Windows-host setuptools wheel installation enters the customer product.
advisories.fix_path: Upstream fix is setuptools 84.1.0. Payments currently pins 80.9.0 and a forced upgrade caused python-dependency-check failure in hosted run 40076515818. Maintain the supported Payments pin in the Linux runtime; require a fresh security assessment before any Windows-native Python component is shipped.
